arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Destination may be supplied as the first argument or via BACKUP_DEST.
# Examples: /mnt/backups, backup-host:/srv/backups
DEST="${1:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup destination not set (pass it as an argument or set BACKUP_DEST)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # Remote destination (host:path).
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        # Local directory or mounted filesystem.
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE"

arguments.command:
set -eu
DEST_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
BACKUP_DEST="$DEST_TMP" ./backup.sh
find "$DEST_TMP" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n'
tar -tzf logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz
rm -f logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz
rm -rf "$DEST_TMP"
